name: Nijagal Betta
note: An offbeat trail featuring ancient fort ruins and rock-cut caves along the highway.
accessibility: Very Easy (Located right next to NH-48; park near CCD/Kamath)

name: Madhugiri Betta
note: The second-largest monolithic rock in Asia, featuring a steep climb through multiple fort gates.
accessibility: Easy (Direct KSRTC buses run from Majestic to Madhugiri town)

name: Savandurga
note: One of the largest monolith hills in Asia, offering a steep, thrilling climb on bare granite rock.
accessibility: Easy (Good road connectivity via Magadi Road or Mysore Road)

name: Muthyala Maduvu Falls
note: Pearl Valley waterfall trek with dense forest and stream crossings, best in monsoon.
accessibility: Very Easy (40km from Bangalore, auto from Anekal)

name: Thottikallu Falls - TK Falls
note: Popular monsoon waterfall with a short forest trail and natural pool.

name: Uttari Betta
note: A scenic day and sunrise trek that passes through village fort walls and lush grasslands.

name: Nandi Hills
note: The most famous weekend getaway, utilizing a historical stone step route.

name: Makalidurga
note: A popular lake-facing hill with an old fort structure overlooking railway tracks.
accessibility: Easy (Can be reached by local train to Makalidurga station)

name: Antargange
note: A unique volcanic rock hill formation famous for nighttime cave exploration.
